live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-trip-3x3-classes-18
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-16: the owner asked for a 3x3 pilot for #123, because whether the trip policy is good has not been established; the development arms keep it off until then.
experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-16, before any result was read. Pilot, not a measurement. It checks that all nine arms run: every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; no config_error; loaded-plan copies match their pins and are absent in no-plan arms; frozen-turn stalls and key outliers are listed. Descriptively, per plan row, the town-only and town+trip columns are compared (deaths, final level, deepest level, keys, paired rescued/newly killed), which is the trip policy's contribution. 18 starts per arm cannot show whether the trip policy is good; that needs a development-size run. On this build the trip switch selects borg-rs#88's additive trip policy (it only adds return requests), the one the development study would use, and the town planner carries #92's Home guard. Trip arms use the specimen's borg.txt thresholds: borg_trip_pack_slack = 2, borg_trip_unknown_stacks = 4. First dispatched on 1c4b351b (runs 43861771985, 43862121256, 43862742496) and cancelled each time before collecting; moved to this specimen before any result was read.
